# from vanilla 00_scripted_triggers.txt
anti_submarine_strategy_required_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			tag = ENG
			not = { is_in_faction_with = GER }
			GER = {
				has_navy_size = {
					type = submarine
					size > 30
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			tag = USA
			not = { is_in_faction_with = GER }
			GER = {
				has_navy_size = {
					type = submarine
					size > 30
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			tag = JAP
			not = { is_in_faction_with = USA }
		}
		AND = {
			has_war = yes
			any_enemy_country = {
				has_navy_size = {
					type = submarine
					size > 30
				}
			}
		}
		convoy_threat > 0.3
	}
}

can_unlock_second_track_of_sf_doctrine = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { sf_trees > 1 } }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = can_unlock_second_track_special_forces_doctrine_yes
			check_variable = { sf_trees > 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		custom_trigger_tooltip = {
			tooltip = can_unlock_second_track_special_forces_doctrine_no
			always = no
		}
	}
}
